decision: Reopen the same scientific project for an offline accuracy-constrained reduction redesign. The consumed fast V2 component and endpoint are evidence only and must not replay.
new_question: Can a higher-precision partitioned online-softmax/value reduction retain a material fraction of the measured Hopper component gain while shrinking the numerical error enough for an A/A-calibrated exact-consumer semantic path?

production_geometry.output_consumer: unchanged production target-verification attention boundary and downstream target logits

physical_hypothesis.change: Keep softmax max, normalizer, partition merge, and value accumulation in FP32, shorten live value state with a two-pass or partitioned exact reduction, and quantize only at the unchanged output boundary.
physical_hypothesis.prediction: Relative L2 and max error fall by at least one order of magnitude without surrendering more than 20% of the prior component time saved; spills and local-memory traffic remain zero or below the measured control.
physical_hypothesis.counter_prediction: If FP32 state restores correctness only by recreating the control's register-residency or HBM cost, the accuracy-constrained packed mechanism is closed.

requirements: bind exact producer/consumer symbols, shapes, strides, dtypes, scale conventions, and current library/runtime alternatives
implement a materially new local and global reduction from the real paged-KV inputs through the consumed output
compare complete outputs with a high-precision reference on production, padded, page-boundary, and extreme-value fixtures
define the numerical gate from a stock A/A envelope plus endpoint token-margin sensitivity rather than bitwise equality
derive useful FLOPs, compulsory bytes, registers, shared memory, grid waves, expected spills, and a non-overlapping whole-request bound
hash-bind a lifecycle-pure H100 component runner only if the offline design remains physically credible
